tools.name: describe_review_source
tools.description: Read this BEFORE scraping. Returns, per platform, the exact submission format: identity fields for the listing, the per-review fields (required vs optional; everything required is visible on the review card), where each lives on the platform's pages, the sort-by-newest and 500-most-recent rules, an

tools.name: check_place
tools.description: Call first. Resolves a Google Maps link or place_id and reports whether a trust result is cached, how fresh it is, and a recommendation: use the cached result, or collect and submit the reviews (also when a cached single-source result would benefit from your corroboration). Never contacts Google.

tools.name: begin_submission
tools.description: Reserves a submission and returns an upload_url. POST the complete JSON payload (format from describe_review_source) to it from your own environment or the user's browser; the HTTP response is the trust report. The URL is a secret that completes the submission under YOUR identity whoever posts to it

tools.name: submit_reviews
tools.description: Submit the review feed inside the tool call. Without submission_id this is a one-shot submission of the whole payload (fine up to about 150 reviews). For more, call begin_submission, then send chunks of up to 150 reviews each with the same submission_id and final=false; send final=true with the last

tools.name: finalize_submission
tools.description: For a submission fed by inline chunks: validates, scores, stores and returns the report. For one already uploaded to its upload_url: returns the stored report. Pending with nothing uploaded yet: says so.

tools.name: get_place_trust
tools.description: The cached fraud analysis for a place: verdict (looks_legit / not_sure / past_manipulation / inflated / manipulated) with its label and a one-sentence summary, letter grade, 0-100 trust score, the adjusted rating credible reviewers actually give (vs the headline average), reviewer-mix tiers, review-

tools.name: list_scored_places
tools.description: The ranked directory of places already analyzed for review fraud, best adjusted rating first (what the site's home and city pages show). 25 per page. Optional city or curated-list filter; the response lists the available cities/lists and their counts.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "begin_submission" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: describe_review_source, check_place, submit_reviews, get_place_trust, list_scored_places · Private data: check_place, begin_submission · Public sink: check_place, begin_submission, submit_reviews, get_place_trust · Destructive: describe_review_source, begin_submission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: describe_review_source, check_place, submit_reviews, get_place_trust, list_scored_places · Private data: check_place, begin_submission · Public sink: check_place, begin_submission, submit_reviews, get_place_trust · Destructive: describe_review_source, begin_submission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
